summary.whatChanges: The CI workflow now also triggers on pull request `closed` events (in addition to opened/synchronize/reopened), while the lint, changed-files diff, and playwright-deps image jobs are guarded to skip whenever the triggering action is `closed`.
behaviorChanges: CI workflow runs are created when a pull request is closed or merged, where previously none were
On closed-PR runs, the lint, 'changed' diff, and playwright-deps-image jobs are skipped
Pull request event types are now explicitly listed, so other PR activity types no longer trigger the workflow
risks: Jobs not shown in the diff that depend on 'changed' outputs may behave unexpectedly or be skipped on closed-PR runs
Extra workflow runs on every PR close consume Actions minutes and may show as skipped/neutral checks
Explicit types list drops previously-covered default-adjacent events if any workflow logic relied on them
